trello.name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL and internal CA certificates with auto-renewal
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Deadline: August 22nd (buffer before September 1st expiry of the public wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com). Renew and deploy the wildcard SSL certificate to the load balancers. Also rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public one, in the same change window. Set up both certificates on cert-manager so they auto-renew going forward. Acceptance criteria: both certs renewed and deployed, cert-manager configured for auto-renewal of both.

trello.name: PDF export feature for reports
trello.desc: Owner: Aisha. Deadline: end of month. Single deliverable with two halves: backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome; frontend adds an export button and a progress state (since big reports take a few seconds). Aisha will complete both halves herself. Additionally, record a short demo GIF for the changelog as part of finishing the feature, per marketing's request. Acceptance criteria: PDF export button functional on frontend with progress state, backend successfully renders reports to PDF via headless Chrome, demo GIF recorded for changelog.

trello.name: Staging environment parity with production
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Two parts in one task: (1) Run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring it in sync with production. (2) Write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge. Acceptance criteria: three pending migrations executed on staging, nightly diff job deployed and posting to infra channel on divergence.
